name: Portoviejo

queries.query: Portoviejo Ecuador official cadastral parcel map catastro geoportal parcelas municipio
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official GAD Municipal de Portoviejo site, its GeoPortal link, the municipal Fénix Geoportal Web AppBuilder item, and the public Consulta de Ficha Predial service. The official guide documents a cadastral ‘Límite – Predios’ layer and lookup by clave predial. The viewer item metadata was public, but the configuration/data request was blocked with HTTP 403 (subscription disabled).

queries.query: Portoviejo Ecuador catastro mapa predial oficial municipio
queries.result: La búsqueda en fuentes de primera parte identificó el GeoPortal/Fénix del GAD Municipal de Portoviejo, la consulta oficial de ficha predial y la guía municipal que indica la capa ‘Límite – Predios’ y la localización mediante clave predial. El elemento público de ArcGIS fue identificable, pero su configuración/datos respondió HTTP 403 (suscripción deshabilitada); no se obtuvo geometría parcelaria anónima.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: GAD Municipal de Portoviejo, through its official municipal GeoPortal/Fénix and cadastral services; the municipal portal separately identifies the Empresa Pública Municipal Registro de la Propiedad del cantón Portoviejo for registry services.

officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: The official municipal portal and guide directly evidence cadastral maps, information catastral, and a ‘Límite – Predios’ layer. This is local cadastral-source evidence, but no live parcel feature response was obtained.
officialSourceAssessment.registryFoundReason: A local municipal cadastral/map custodian and public cadastral viewer/procedure were evidenced; source discovery is not source integration or adapter qualification.
